name: Tri-gauge risk-on confluence (low VIX + tight credit + calm put/call) arms the SPY/QQQ trend
rationale: Thesis: no single vol/credit/sentiment gauge times equities reliably (VIX-alone and credit-alone both fail in different regimes). The orthogonal structure is CONFLUENCE: require three independent risk channels to AGREE that premia are being paid before taking the broad-index trend long — vix_level below a fitted ceiling (implied-vol complacency), credit_spread below a fitted tight level (credit calm), putcall_ratio below a fitted complacency level (options crowd not hedging), AND ret_Nd>0 (trend up). Because all three gauges are BOUNDED, their fitted levels genuinely bind, and their AGREEMENT is a higher-conviction, lower-false-positive regime tag than any one alone. Slow, daily, long-only on liquid index ETFs — the boring low-capacity no-leverage trade a vol desk skips. Disconfirmers: (1) Index-trend-alone (ret_Nd>0 only, no gauges) — if the confluence does not beat it, the regime filter is dead weight. (2) Each single-gauge gate run separately (vix-only, credit-only, putcall-only, each paired with the same trend) — if any ONE alone matches the three-gauge confluence, the agreement adds no info and the simpler single gate wins. The confluence must beat the best single-gauge variant AND the un-gated trend, net of fees and net of the return given up by sitting out non-confluent windows.
catalyst: three independent risk gauges (implied vol, credit, options positioning) simultaneously in their calm/risk-on zone while the index trend is up
